shortDescription: CoreWeave Inc. NASDAQ:CRWV fell 2.10% after announcing a $3.0 billion offering of convertible senior notes due April 2033 in a private placement, with a $500 million option for initial purchasers, and separately established an at-the-market program covering up to 35 million Class A shares.CoreWeave…

children: fell 2.10% after announcing a $3.0 billion offering of convertible senior notes due April 2033 in a private placement, with a $500 million option for initial purchasers, and separately established an at-the-market program covering up to 35 million Class A shares.

CoreWeave says the ATM supports moving its credit profile toward investment grade. It currently pays 9.250% on notes due 2030, 9.000% and 9.750% on notes due 2031, and 9.625% and 8.500% on notes due 2032.

In the second quarter, CoreWeave's net debt reached $29 billion and it paid $640 million of net interest on revenue of $2.6 billion, roughly a quarter of the top line. Revenue more than doubled, but interest expense grew faster, up 140% from $267 million a year earlier. Adjusted EBITDA reached $1.5 billion.

title: CoreWeave Stock Falls as It Raises $3 Billion
